mentions.name: KAM Remake WASM port
mentions.description: A WebAssembly (WASM) port of Knights & Merchants, based on the Delphi rewrite KAM Remake, running in the browser. Multiplayer already works, with a public release planned. The porting work involved WASM, OPFS, JSPI, and other browser APIs, plus Pascal.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am vibe-porting an old game, Knights & Merchants(actually its Delphi rewrite - KAM Remake) to WASM. It's going well, I even have multiplayer working, will release it publicly at some point.
